notes:
Inbound SMB lead — founder-led engineering team. Evaluating Redwood hosted API as primary self-serve path. Key themes from discovery:
- Workloads: customer support bot + internal doc search + short-form summarization for chat replies.
- Traffic: early stage, baseline ~2-3 QPS, expected peak ~8-12 QPS during business hours.
- Latency targets: P95 <= 350ms for live chat; willing to accept 500-600ms for longer summarization jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Target cost per 1k input+output tokens ~<$0.50 in production. Wants guidance on quality vs cost tradeoffs.
- Model shortlist: exploring Llama 2 (13B), Mistral-Instruct (7B/8B), and Qwen family (7B/14B). Asks: which variant gives best f1 for our support prompts vs tokens billed? Also interested in quantized / distilled variants for cost.
- Routing/fallback: prefer single hosted endpoint; open to automatic fallback to a cheaper model for non-critical queries. Wants to understand impact on output consistency.
- Features required: streaming, function/tool-calls for ticket creation, structured output (JSON) support.
- Security: SOC2 required for contract, SSO/SAML later, audit logs mandatory. Public cloud acceptable; no VPC right now.
- POC plan proposed: 1) Redwood hosted API keys for 2-week POC using 3 model variants (Llama2-13B, Mistral-Instruct-7B, Qwen-14B), 2) run prompt set (35 canonical queries) and measure accuracy, latency P95, and cost/1k tokens, 3) review results and pick a production variant + fallback policy.
- Quotes/feedback from founder on call: "We want a clear tradeoff table — show us where quality drops and how much we save."
- Internal constraints: procurement needs one-page pricing + SOC2 attestation. Finance will review ARR band for commit thresholds.
- AE/SE notes: provide sample request/response size estimates, example streaming curl, tokenization guidance, and suggested batch sizes. Recommend Redwood Optimize report for quick batching/caching suggestions.
Next steps (short): schedule 30m technical Q&A with SE, provide POC checklist + quickstart link, share SOC2 report and sample perf logs. SE to prepare preliminary cost comparison (approx cost per 1k tokens) for the three model families using our sample prompt set.
